models.summary: Unlimited-OCR is a vision-language model for optical character recognition handling long-horizon document parsing and extraction tasks.
Laguna S 2.1 is a 118B-parameter mixture-of-experts model with 8B active parameters, optimized for agentic coding with 1M-token context.
Inkling is a 66-layer sparse mixture-of-experts multimodal model accepting text, image, and audio inputs for conversational and coding tasks.
Solar Open 2 is a 250B-parameter hybrid-attention MoE model activating 15B per token, designed for agentic workflows and 1M-token context.
Qwen3.6-27B-Fable-Fusion is a fine-tuned multi-stage 27B model exceeding 700 on ARC-C in both 8-bit and 4-bit quantizations.
Nanbeige4.2-3B is a 3B compact agentic model with looped transformer architecture for tool-use, coding, and reasoning tasks.
Ternary Bonsai 27B is a 2-bit ternary-quantized model retaining 95% of FP16 intelligence while fitting in ~7.2GB for on-device use.
GLM-5.2 is a long-horizon model with stable 1M-token context, advanced coding, and sparse MoE architecture with MIT license.
Bonsai 27B is a 1-bit binary-quantized 27B model retaining ~90% FP16 intelligence while deploying in ~3.9GB for reasoning and coding.
Mage-Flow is a compact 4B generative stack using rectified flow for efficient text-to-image and instruction-based image editing.
